headline: Funding for lead hazard reduction grants, including $4,181,173.39 and $900,000, plus transfer of $189,279.25 for Weston Road and S. Willow Street intersection improvements.
summary: Items cover funds for the Document Preservation Project, the Aged and Infirmed Shelter Project, and FY27 STOP Violence Against Women Act (VAWA) funding. The agenda also includes a report on the City's ARPA funds spent through September 30, 2026.
items: Accept and spend $3,706 for CIP C040080127 Document Preservation Project.
Accept and spend $15,000 for CIP C160060227 Aged and Infirmed Shelter Project.
Accept and spend $4,181,173.39 for CIP C200060427 Lead Hazard Reduction Grant.
Accept and spend $900,000 for CIP C200060527 2026 Lead Hazard Reduction Grant - HH Supplement.
Accept and spend $93,000 for CIP C330040527 FY27 STOP Violence Against Women Act (VAWA).
Transfer and spend $189,279.25 for CIP 713221 Weston Road & S. Willow Street Intersection Improvements.
Report from Jeff Belanger, Planning and Community Development Director, on City ARPA fund spending through September 30, 2026.

COMMITTEE ON COMMUNITY IMPROVEMENT 
November 17, 2026 at 5:30 PM 
Aldermanic Chambers, City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
Members: Aldermen Burkush, Vincent, Barry, Goonan, Terrio 
 
AGENDA 
 
 
The Chairman calls the meeting to order. 
  
The Clerk calls the roll. 
  
1. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorization providing for the acceptance 
and expenditure of funds in the amount of $3,706 for CIP C040080127 
Document Preservation Project. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure?

6. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorizations providing for the transfer and 
expenditure of funds in the amount of $189,279.25 for CIP 713221 Weston 
Road & S. Willow Street Intersection Improvements.

Director, submitting the expenditure report of the City's ARPA funds through

If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.
